results.name: Minimum Password Length
results.reason: Observed value is below the required minimum.
results.remediation: Configure the minimum password length to at least 14 characters.

results.name: Password Complexity
results.remediation: Enable password complexity requirements through the applicable security policy.

results.name: Account Lockout Threshold
results.reason: Observed value falls outside the approved range.
results.remediation: Configure account lockout to trigger after no more than five invalid authentication attempts while avoiding a value of zero.

results.name: Guest Account Disabled
results.remediation: Disable the built-in Guest account unless a documented business requirement exists.

results.name: Domain Firewall Enabled
results.remediation: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the Domain profile.

results.name: Private Firewall Enabled
results.remediation: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the Private profile.

results.name: Public Firewall Enabled
results.remediation: Enable the Windows Defender Firewall for the Public profile.

results.name: Remote Desktop Exposure Review
results.reason: Setting is enabled and requires analyst review to confirm business justification and safeguards.
results.remediation: Confirm that Remote Desktop is required. If it is not needed, disable it. If required, restrict access and apply strong authentication controls.

results.name: Remote Desktop Network Level Authentication
results.remediation: Enable Network Level Authentication whenever Remote Desktop is enabled.

results.name: SMBv1 Disabled
results.remediation: Disable SMBv1 and use supported SMB protocol versions.

results.name: PowerShell Script Block Logging
results.reason: Observed value does not match baseline.
results.remediation: Enable PowerShell Script Block Logging to improve visibility into PowerShell activity.

results.name: Process Creation Auditing
results.remediation: Enable process creation auditing to improve endpoint investigation and detection capabilities.

results.name: Automatic Security Updates
results.remediation: Enable automatic security updates or manage the system through an approved centralized patch-management process.

results.name: Endpoint Protection Enabled
results.remediation: Enable approved endpoint protection and ensure protection services remain active.

results.name: Local Administrator Count
results.reason: Observed value exceeds the permitted maximum.
results.remediation: Review local administrator membership and reduce privileged accounts to the minimum required for business operations.
